text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to copy human intelligence. Instead of following only fixed instructions, AI systems can learn from data and make decisions. Machine learning is a central part of AI: computers find patterns in large amounts of information and improve with experience. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses artificial neural networks, inspired by the human brain. Today, AI is part of daily life. It suggests films on streaming services, helps maps find the fastest route, translates languages, and powers chatbots and virtual assistants on our phones.
